description: This file defines a base class for media playback tests involving GStreamer elements, including setup and callback handling for video and audio elements, and various test scenarios for media tasks.

classes.name: TasksTestsBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, expectations, and trigger methods for media playback tests involving GStreamer elements.

methods.name: expectSetupVideoElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up a video element, including factory checks and signal connections.

methods.name: expectSetupAudioElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up an audio element, including factory checks and signal connections.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementOnly
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up a standard video element without specific sink types.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementWesterossink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up a Westerossink video element with rectangle configuration.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementAmlhalasink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up an Amlhalasink video element with specific object property settings.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementPendingGeometryNonWesterissink
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up a video element with pending geometry when not using Westerossink.

methods.name: shouldSetupAudioElementOnly
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up only an audio element.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting a video underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates triggering the video underflow callback.

methods.name: shouldSetAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting an audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates triggering the audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Executes a setup element task.

methods.name: setPipelineToNull
methods.description: Sets the pipeline reference in context to null.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometryFailure
methods.description: Executes a set video geometry task expecting failure, verifying pending geometry remains unchanged.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Sets expectation for setting the Westerossink rectangle.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometrySuccess
methods.description: Executes a set video geometry task expecting success and updates pending geometry.

methods.name: setAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Marks all sources as attached in the context.

methods.name: shouldScheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Sets expectation for scheduling all sources attached.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Executes a setup source task and verifies source assignment.

methods.name: shouldSetGstVolume
methods.description: Sets expectation for setting the GStreamer stream volume.

methods.name: triggerSetVolume
methods.description: Executes a set volume task.
